title: Non-Destructive Schedule Sync & Native Class Reminder Engine
releaseNotes: Non-Destructive Schedule Sync: Upgraded cloud sync to compare and update only modified class fields, permanently preserving your reminder preferences and notes.
Reliable Class Reminders: Connected the native background engine to deliver audible and vibrating heads-up notifications before classes start.
Subsystem Stability: Guaranteed seamless real-time operation across the unremovable notification, home screen widgets, and task tracking.
